channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: As Celebrini takes Olympics star turn, what’s next for Sharks?
item.description: As Macklin Celebrini gains valuable experience with Team Canada, San Jose is hoping to surround its 19-year-old star with more talent.

item.title: Ropes and roses: How SF’s kinkiest people do it on Valentine’s Day
item.description: Forget Hallmark cards. Here’s what SF’s sex-party crowd gets up to.

item.title: Teachers strikes could become a contagion — unless we commit to these reforms
item.description: What city and state leaders must do to make sure the same mistakes aren’t made in the next contract cycle.

item.title: A tech CEO says AI is about to do to everyone what it is doing to coders. Is he right?
item.description: Matt Shumer’s viral essay comparing AI to the early days of Covid has more than 80 million views. The concern is understandable. The timeline is another story.

item.title: An East Bay school district struck a deal with its teachers union. Then came the bill
item.description: School mergers, eliminated aides, and gutted programs follow a hard-fought contract victory. Could San Francisco face a similar path?

item.title: No Bay Area mom subculture is too niche for ‘Overheard Moms’
item.description: Megan Neal explains how she has quickly built a devoted following with her highly specialized brand of satire.

item.title: Bay FC ripped up its blueprint, and is charging forward with a new superpower
item.description: Kay Cossington and Emma Coates believe a roster anchored by young stars including Claire Hutton will transform a franchise that underachieved.

item.title: The child-care diaries of San Francisco
item.description: Eight families open their books to reveal the true cost of having kids in the city.

item.title: For Logan Webb, the Giants’ next era is all about playoff success
item.description: The team’s ace is just as frustrated as fans about finishing around .500, but Webb believes the Tony Vitello era will be different.

item.title: ‘Star Trek: Starfleet Academy’ wants you to flash the Vulcan salute at Pier 39
item.description: Iconic franchise celebrates 60 years and its latest show with various promos across SF.
